description: This Java class, JsLanguageFilesMappingTransform, implements a FreeMarker TemplateTransformModel to map JavaScript language files based on a library name and locale. It is used within a web application to facilitate dynamic language resource loading.

classes.name: JsLanguageFilesMappingTransform
classes.description: A FreeMarker template transformation class that retrieves the appropriate JavaScript language file path based on a library name and request locale.

methods.name: getWriter
methods.description: Returns a Writer that captures the library name, then upon closing, writes the path to the correct language file based on the request's locale.
